Eligibility.metaTitle: Can I take traffic school? Eligibility check
Eligibility.metaDescription: Answer 5 yes/no questions to see whether California traffic school is likely an option for your ticket.
Eligibility.title: Can I take traffic school?
Eligibility.intro: Answer 5 quick questions. Nothing you enter is saved.
Eligibility.disclaimer: This is general guidance for a demo. Your court always makes the final decision.

questions.validLicense: Do you have a valid driver's license?
questions.courtAllowed: Has the court allowed you to attend traffic school for this ticket?
questions.noRecentSchool: Have you gone at least 18 months without attending traffic school?
questions.nonCommercial: Were you driving a non-commercial vehicle with a non-commercial license?
questions.eligibleViolation: Is your ticket for a minor moving violation (for example speeding or a missed stop sign)?

Eligibility.eligibleText: Based on your answers, traffic school looks like an option. Confirm with your court, then choose your course language.
Eligibility.notEligibleTitle: Traffic school is probably not an option

nextStep.validLicense: Traffic school needs a valid driver's license. Contact your court about other options.
nextStep.courtAllowed: Only the court can allow traffic school. Ask your court, or check the notice it sent you.
nextStep.noRecentSchool: You can usually attend traffic school only once in 18 months. Your court can tell you what to do instead.
nextStep.nonCommercial: Commercial drivers and vehicles usually can't use traffic school to mask a ticket. Ask your court about your options.
nextStep.eligibleViolation: Some violations don't qualify. Your court decides, so ask it whether yours does.
